scope: CPU-only transfer of recorded historical HF/FP32 scores to exact SHA-identical current native arrays and SHA-identical token histories; no new reference inference. Primary rank0 only.
oracle: Historical CPU fp32 HF NemotronHForCausalLM; exact affine dequantization of MLX4bit checkpoint, with dt clamp and expert-forward adaptations documented in nem_ref.py. Not FP64.
limitations: Reference arrays are not retained in this package: errors and reference margins are historical rounded CSV values, not newly recomputed.
Original Torch/Transformers runtime versions are not recorded in these retained oracle files; current native loaded-library identities do not supply them.
Reference top2 token IDs are absent; reference top1/top2 margin is retained, not both contender IDs.
No tie waiver or mismatch exemption; unmatched chat/code teacher rows and code_long are excluded.
Exact array SHA implies complete vocabulary bytes match; CSV native margin comparison only checks published decimal rounding.
